models_evaluated: retrieval-grounded LLM-based conversational agent (CGM interpretation and diabetes counseling)

links.outcome: LLM agent vs clinician-authored responses on six quality dimensions rated by blinded clinicians
links.effect: CA scored higher than clinicians (mean 4.37 vs 3.58); estimated difference 0.782 points (95% CI 0.692-0.872; P<.001); largest for empathy (1.062) and actionability (0.992).
links.quote: The CA received higher quality scores than clinician responses (mean 4.37 vs 3.58), with an estimated mean difference of 0.782 points (95% CI 0.692-0.872; P<.001).

screen.reason: The study conducts a blinded multi-rater evaluation comparing a retrieval-grounded LLM conversational agent's responses against clinician responses across synthetic/dataset CGM cases, but does not compare outcomes with vs without an organizational deployment practice or safeguard.
